title: WikiSkill turns agent experience into persistent, testable skills
friendlyTitle: WikiSkill helps AI agents remember lessons from earlier work
summary: WikiSkill separates raw agent traces, a persistent wiki of distilled lessons and executable skills that can be tested and rolled back. Across the authors’ benchmarks, the method outperformed earlier skill-evolution approaches in most model and task settings, and some skills transferred between model families.
friendlySummary: The system keeps raw work records, turns them into useful notes and tests new instructions before accepting them. The researchers found that these skills often improved several models.
whyItMatters: A durable knowledge layer can help recurring agents improve without retraining the underlying model. For production use, the useful pattern is to preserve evidence, validate each proposed skill change and keep rollback available rather than letting an agent rewrite its own instructions unchecked.
friendlyWhyItMatters: An assistant may repeat fewer mistakes if it can keep tested lessons, while people still have a way to reject bad updates.
